column1: # Cards that had a dirac/support/refused entry and no longer do, with the proof the defect is fixed.
# card <TAB> proof <TAB> why. The proof is a TestXxx that exists, or a dirac/oracle/testdata/repro/<name>.repro.json
# that replays clean (no divergence, no unmodelled stall) on a raw table of its own cards.
# TestUnrefusalNeedsProof fails for a card that had an entry at the merge base with land and has none now

column3: the hidden public-origin pick now applies LibraryPosition$ (engine/effects/zone_hidden.go places what it moved), so the picked card lands on top of the library as dirac puts it
